## Frozen closing proofs

Settings/source frozen at 09:57:24 UTC, base `5f941abe`, tool SHA-256 `27949192412d5b9a367a521689be33bbec6eaac9bcc6c0bf39edb65d70fd23c6`. Full current starting kit includes a lightning hearth, with its fuel deducted. No replenishment, forced discovery or trait selection.

- Discovery within two years: **18/20 ≥16 passes**.

- Strict reopens at initial state, first noticed/watched/taught acquisitions when present, and final state: **zero failures**. Failed/partial work is covered by focused native tests, not claimed as a phase in every random run.

There is no third set or retuning.

## Spread diagnosis and storage

All fourteen failed first-set scenes reproduce their original end digests, first discoveries and holder counts. Their 135 missing learners all end at skill 0; 32 have no observation credit and the remainder never reach five full credits. Of these learners, 133 accepted no lesson of any recipe; the other two accepted one each, not necessarily sharp-stone. Hourly probes found 70 never near active sharp work, and no sampled paused sharp lesson. Each scene still has 3–9 kind sharp-stone holders; missing learners have 32,216 comfortable-near-free-kind-holder hourly samples in total. Public history records only four taught sharp acquisitions across these fourteen scenes. This points to scarce completed observation/practice rather than absent kind teachers. Hourly sampling cannot distinguish every offer, refusal, material-fit shortage or interruption; no precise refusal count or causal calibration is claimed. Input availability and teaching opportunity calibration are proposed review questions; no T values were changed.

Storage measurements and proposed retention work are recorded in [M3 result](../IMPLEMENTATION.md#m3-result). Live-food/fire indexes preserve stable identities and exact digests while skipping spent stock. The food regression covers transfers, kinds, births/deletions, direct edits, shuffled handles and unchanged save bytes.

[Raw repair gate evidence](M3-REPAIR-GATES.json) retains the pre-run freeze, completed seed records, timings and exclusions. The first repair build's HIST2 record cap was a real own-save failure: the repaired reader bounds records by encoded bytes and validates links in linear time. It reopens the formerly failing diagnostic with its exact digest. Gate arithmetic and owner disposition live in M3 result, rather than a second status narrative here.

The repair routine was interrupted by the coordinator, not completed; the owner stopped further builder checks/exports and handed the routine to the coordinator. No new APK contains these repairs yet. No second full audit ran. Five concurrent gates were permitted only after measuring serial seed 7101 (210.4 MiB) and the repaired diagnostic (264.2 MiB), within the 7 GiB working budget.

## Checks and review

Touched closing strict-save/continuation regression: six assertions passed, 3.02 s /35.1 MiB; opaque History repair: seven app cases passed. Carried-food regression plus affected fire/save tests: 12 cases, 4,166 assertions, 3.58 s /40.7 MiB; lint/rules passed.

One integrated self-review (10:00–10:04 UTC) covered 360×800 portrait, large text, History and 800×360 rotation using software-rendered captures. The one bounded repair made History opaque. Cloud audio used Dummy: listening quality remains unmeasured.

Pre-review routine **PASS**, 931.49 s /3.137 GiB peak: native simulation/view, ten one/four-worker digest suites, catalogue, formats/lints/source rules, 54 scripts/96 Godot cases, 165 tool cases, file/ID checks. Shared-header changes required 34 simulation and 13 view translation-unit lints plus 32 source-rule reads; unchanged passed files were retained. The initial routine took 290.56 s and found one unchecked-optional lint in the new test; explicit guard repaired it. No initial whole-routine PASS is claimed. The single milestone audit **PASS**, 3,314.28 s (55 min 14.28 s), 3.133 GiB peak: GCC/UBSAN and ARM/NDK native suites passed, TSan passed all 301 cases/1,768,842 assertions with no reported race, ten digest suites matched in all twelve runs including shuffled ties, 100 crash kills matched the unbroken result, and six planted oddities/repeat/recovery checks passed. Native flags/instruction scans, 96 Godot cases, 165 tool cases and file/ID checks passed. Build phase: 1,990 s; native/check phase: 1,314 s. The owner’s 12:08 instruction arrived after this audit had finished; no QEMU process remained to kill. The now-reduced audit policy keeps cross-compiler/M3 digests, TSan, shuffled ties and kill/scene/repeat only (owner, 10 October 2026); five new orchestration regressions passed in 5.853 s. Exact completed proofs seed its input fingerprints; no second full audit was run. No sustained rendered cloud or physical-phone measurement is claimed. Retained full-kit seed 1001 and idea pair 2001 also match their host end digests under GCC/UBSAN: 78.20 s /95.8 MiB and 20.75 s /77.8 MiB. These test cross-build equivalence, not frequency; ARM/NDK under QEMU also matches all four retained end digests: 240.83 s /94.7 MiB for learning, 52.37 s /70.4 MiB for the idea pair. This is emulation, not a physical-phone result.

The unconsumed-display-trail memory bug is fixed separately (`b7153b27`): synchronous seeks/recovery retain only their displayed endpoint. Regression verifies bounded knowledge copies and exact state. The then-current 297-case simulation suite measured 122.3 MiB; affected full Godot suite fell from a stopped 7.12 GiB case to 349.3 MiB. The native view's explicit historical-window stress retains 3.13 GiB; builds use two workers and long gates are memory-budgeted below ~7 GiB total.
